# testing_x_pagination_offset_limits (Data Source)

XPaginationOffsetLimits DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "testing_x_pagination_offset_limits" "my_xpaginationoffsetlimits" {
  string_request = "...my_string_request..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
